title: Include 'echofields' in public and admin URLs

requirements.text: Update the frontend routing so that all public clue/progress pages are accessible under a base path that includes the word "echofields" (for example: "/echofields/..."), without breaking the existing URL-based progression behavior. Ensure any admin management area routes also include "echofields" in their path (for example: "/echofields/admin").

quotes: can u include the words 'echofields' in the url?

acceptanceCriteria: Visiting a public clue URL under the "echofields" base path (e.g., /echofields/<clue-id>) renders the same clue content that would otherwise be shown for that clue.
Admin pages are reachable under a route that includes "echofields" and still require Internet Identity authentication for admin actions.
No public clue/progress pages are exposed at the old top-level routes if they would omit "echofields" (either redirect to the new routes or only register the new routes).

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutablePaths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor (all logic in backend/main.mo).
nonGoals: Purchasing/configuring a custom domain name containing "echofields" (only in-app routes/base paths are in scope).
Changing the clue content model or admin authorization model beyond what is necessary to support the new URL path structure.
